description: This Java class defines an HTTP route for serving Prometheus metrics. It provides a static method to build a route that Prometheus can scrape to collect metrics data. The class encapsulates the setup of an Akka HTTP route that returns the scrape data from a PrometheusReporter instance.

classes.name: PrometheusReporterRoute
classes.description: A utility class providing an Akka HTTP route for serving Prometheus metrics. It includes a static method to generate the route that exposes the metrics data from a PrometheusReporter instance.

methods.name: buildPrometheusReporterRoute
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka HTTP Route that serves Prometheus metrics scraped from the provided PrometheusReporter instance.
